pages.text: Use a $(item)Totem Radiation Coating$() on a Radiation Shielding Panel, Window or Door to coat it: one tin per block, one for a whole door. It stays on when the block is broken and placed again.

Coated shielding all round a totem, within 32 blocks, weakens its $(l:totem/radiation)radiation$(): each coated layer takes a fifth off how far away it is seen, up to four.$(br2)A coated roof alone does nothing, and an open door does not count.
pages.title: Layers

pages.text: Pure Illyrium Dust, Lead Plates and Tetrium Dust make four.
